# CallTimeout

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

Sends a message to a port and blocks until the server replies, or until a timeout.

| Number | Selector | Blocking | Since |
|---|---|---|---|
| `0x05` SVC_CALL | — | yes | 2.0 |

```c
SvcResult CallTimeout(Handle port, uint32_t xlen, Handle grant_handle, Duration timeout);
```

**Registers:** `(port, xlen, grant, timeout) -> r0 status, r1 reply length, r3 granted handle`

The request is the first `xlen` bytes of the caller's message box; the reply arrives in the same place. Callers queue by priority, and the server runs at the caller's priority while serving (priority inheritance).

The timeout covers the whole call: waiting to be received and waiting for the reply. When it expires the call is withdrawn. A server that already took it finds its reply capability gone: a late Reply() returns ERR_BADHANDLE, and a late ReplyRecv() just waits for the next call, so the stale answer cannot be mistaken for the reply to a later call.

## Parameters

| Name | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `port` | in | Port handle with PERM_SEND. |
| `xlen` | in | Request length in bytes, at most MSG_BUF_SIZE. |
| `grant_handle` | in | [Handle](../types.md#handle) (with PERM_TXFR) to copy to the server, or -1. |
| `timeout` | in | Milliseconds to wait for the reply, or TIMEOUT_INFINITE. TIMEOUT_POLL always returns ERR_TIMEOUT, since a call cannot finish without blocking. |

## Returns

r0 is the status; r1 the reply length; r3 a handle granted back, or -1.

## Errors

| Error | Condition |
|---|---|
| [`ERR_TIMEOUT`](../errors.md#err_timeout) | No reply within `timeout`. |
| [`ERR_OVERFLOW`](../errors.md#err_overflow) | `xlen` is larger than MSG_BUF_SIZE. |
| [`ERR_BADHANDLE`](../errors.md#err_badhandle) | `port` or `grant_handle` is not a live handle. |
| [`ERR_BADTYPE`](../errors.md#err_badtype) | `port` is not a port. |
| [`ERR_NOPERM`](../errors.md#err_noperm) | `port` lacks PERM_SEND, or `grant_handle` lacks PERM_TXFR. |
| [`ERR_DEAD`](../errors.md#err_dead) | The port died, or the server died before replying. |
| [`ERR_NOMEM`](../errors.md#err_nomem) | The server's handle table is full (when granting). |
